name: Artem Slugin
description: Artem is Tech Lead at 0xbow, building programmable privacy and shielded-pool infrastructure on Ethereum. He leads engineering across the stack: the Privacy Pools v2 protocol and its account-abstraction and paymaster layer, the Association Set Provider that keeps the pools compliant without collapsing their privacy guarantees, the TypeScript and Rust SDKs, and the ongoing port of the system onto new chains. Seven years in crypto, five of them in protocol engineering.
